name: Daily transaction volume
sql: SELECT full_date, transactions, failed FROM mart_daily_transactions ORDER BY full_date

name: Completed value by merchant category (MXN)
sql: SELECT category, completed_mxn_minor / 100 AS completed_mxn FROM mart_category_volume ORDER BY value_rank

name: Failure rate by day (%)
sql: SELECT full_date, failure_pct FROM mart_daily_transactions ORDER BY full_date

name: Top 10 customers by activity
sql: SELECT activity_rank, customer_id, customer_name, current_segment, transactions, gross_mxn_minor / 100 AS gross_mxn FROM mart_customer_activity ORDER BY activity_rank, customer_id LIMIT 10

name: Loan repayments by month
sql: SELECT CAST(year AS TEXT) || '-' || LPAD(CAST(month AS TEXT), 2, '0') AS month, on_time, late, missed FROM mart_loan_repayments ORDER BY year, month

name: Rejected records by rule
sql: SELECT rule_name, failed_records FROM mart_data_quality_rules WHERE failed_records > 0 ORDER BY failed_records DESC

name: Pipeline step duration (ms)
sql: SELECT pipeline, step, executions, failures, avg_ms, max_ms FROM mart_pipeline_performance ORDER BY pipeline, step
